subject: SLA packaging and commitment discount — fastpath requirements
messages:
From: Helen Park <helen.park@stripecorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stripecorp.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA options and enterprise discount inquiry

Jonas —

Thanks for taking this. Quick context: StripeCorp is evaluating Redwood for our fraud-scoring and customer support summarization pipelines. We have a target go-live in Q4 and are sizing for ~200M tokens/mo initially, growing to ~600M in 12 months. Two asks from procurement and engineering:

1) Can you confirm uptime tiers (we need a 99.95% baseline and want an option to buy up to 99.99%), the committed response windows for P1/P2/P3 incidents, and what on-call coverage looks like for Gold vs. Silver?

2) Pricing: for an initial 24-month commitment (expected TCV ~$1.2M), what discount bands do you offer? Procurement is specifically asking whether a 15%+ ARR discount is feasible when combined with an onboarding credit and a 2-month ramp credit.

3) Procurement would like a short mutual action plan and a prefilled SOW/DocuSign to speed approval cycles.

Could you send a short write-up and the MAP + preliminary pricing grid? We can schedule 30 minutes if it's easier to walk it.

Thanks —
Helen Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
StripeCorp

[Attachment: procurement-stripecorp-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@stripecorp.com>
Cc: procurement@stripecorp.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA options and enterprise discount inquiry

Hi Helen —

Appreciate the details and the clear asks. Attached is a concise SLA + pricing overview (Redwood_SLA_Overview_v3.pdf) and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_StripeCorp_Q3.xlsx). Key points inline below so your procurement/legal team has something to react to immediately: 

- Uptime tiers:
  * Silver: 99.95% uptime, P1 response target 1 hour, P2 4 hours, P3 next business day.
  * Gold: 99.99% uptime, P1 response target 30 minutes, P2 2 hours, P3 within 8 business hours.
  * Failover: regional failover options available as an add-on with SLA-backed latency SLOs.

- On-call/escalation: Gold includes a named escalation contact and quarterly incident drills; Silver includes 24/7 triage with 8x5 follow-up engineering.

- Pricing (illustrative monthly rates for the committed capacity):
  * Silver: $45k/mo (covers up to 250M tokens/mo), overage at $0.00018/token.
  * Gold: $70k/mo (covers up to 400M tokens/mo), overage at $0.00015/token.

- Discounting guidance:
  * 1yr commit: up to 10% off list
  * 2yr commit: up to 15% off list (requires executive approval for >15%)
  * For deals >$500k ARR we typically consider onboarding credits (one-time) or startup credits applied to first 90 days.

Proposal for next step: 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the MAP and walk procurement through the DocuSign flow. If it helps we can draft a 2-year SOW with a 15% discount + $30k onboarding credit for review.

Sending to Karthik and Kimberly to confirm concessions and operational feasibility — will circle back before DocuSign.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_SLA_Overview_v3.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: SLA options and enterprise discount inquiry — need approval on discount + credits

Team — forwarding Helen's note and my proposed framing. TL;DR: StripeCorp asked for 15%+ for 24 months plus onboarding + ramp credits. I recommended we offer 15% + $30k onboarding credit and a 2-month token credit (to smooth go-live).

Questions for you:
- Karthik: can we livebook 15% on the pricing grid for a 24-mo commit (DEAL-2026-5587)? If not, what's your floor and any preferred structure (e.g., smaller % + credits)?
- Kimberly: operationally, Gold at 99.99% with a named escalation contact — does that require dedicated shifts or additional headcount on our side? If so, what should we price into the retainer or on-call surcharge?

I want to send a concrete counter-offer to Helen today so procurement doesn't stall.

Thanks —
Jonas

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: SLA options and enterprise discount inquiry — need approval on discount + credits

Jonas —

I think we should avoid committing to a straight 15% list discount at that scale without an operational hedge. My recommendation:

- Offer a 12% list discount for a 24-month commitment, plus a token credit equivalent to ~2 months of expected consumption (~$24k) applied over the first 60 days.
- Alternatively, we could do 10% discount + $40k onboarding credit if procurement insists on a larger one-time credit; that keeps ARR pricing cleaner while preserving margin.
- On SLA tiers: reserve 99.99% Gold for deals with an additional availability retainer (we can price a retainer at $8k/mo) — keeps our exposure low while giving StripeCorp the guarantees they want.

I attached a quick pricing model so you can run the math for the two options. If they need >12% we should escalate to execs with a clear showback of margin impact.

-Karthik

[Attachment: pricing_model_sheet.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@stripecorp.com>, procurement@stripecorp.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Final proposal: hybrid discount + onboarding credit for 24-month commitment

Hi Helen —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review we want to put a clean, executable option on the table to keep your procurement window tight. Final offer (can be reflected in the SOW/DocuSign):

Option A (preferred compromise) — 24 month
- List: Gold tier (99.99% uptime, priority escalation) priced at $70k/mo
- Commercials: 14% off list for 24 months
- One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 applied in the first invoice cycle
- Startup consumption credit: $20,000 token credit applied over first 60 days
- Requirement: Gold SLA and named escalation included; if StripeCorp requires additional regional failover retainer, we can add that as an optional line item.

Option B — margin-protecting alternative
- 12% off list for 24 months + $24k token credit (applied over initial 60 days).

Next steps: if Option A is acceptable, I will prepare the SOW and the DocuSign packet (link below) and we can get signatures this week. If you prefer Option B, let me know and I’ll adjust the MAP accordingly.

DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-StripeCorp-SLA
HubSpot (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890/DEAL-2026-5587

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
